entities.summary: Ata-Malik Juvayni was a bureaucrat and historian from the Juvayni family who served under the Mongol Empire. He is known for composing the Tarikh-i Jahangushay, an important account on the history of Central Asia and the 13th-century Mongol invasion of Muslim world.
